# scripts/file_size_gate.py runs core's file-size gate on this tree. This
# repository's CI cannot read the private core repository, so the gate and its
# import closure are copied here rather than fetched, at the commit below.

# verbatim: tests/test_file_size_gate_11683.py refuses a vendored file whose
# git blob id is not the one listed, and a file under vendor/prism/ that is
# not listed. Never edit a vendored file here: change it in core, then
# resync (docs/file-size-budget.md -> "Resync the vendored gate").
